question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the given set of classes.

Paragraph, Letter, Word, Sentence
solution:
The diagram that best represents the relationship between Paragraph, Letter, Word, and Sentence is shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28b704685d5f1064ccc145a66d8528c8169232ce84b557e80953b1639f853bff.png] 

Letters are the smallest unit and are used to form Words.

Words are then grouped to form Sentences.

Sentences are grouped to form Paragraphs.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
